tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Find tools in the EasyCanDo catalog for one step of a build. Give a short query saying what the step does, and have and want when you know what goes in and what should come out. Returns up to 10 previews, best first: slug, one-line summary, the capability that matched with its input and output types

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get the full record of up to 5 tools: each capability with its input and output types, price and limits; API status, sign-up and auth; price tier and free tier; ways in (web API, SDKs, official MCP); docs, pricing and site links; terms; ranking; and the date it was checked. Takes slugs from search_t

tools.name: find_chains
tools.description: Find tools that turn one kind of input into another: single tools that do it in one capability, and chains of two tools in a row with the type passed between them. Use it when search_tools finds no single tool for a step. Give a query saying what the chain is for, so the best chains come first.

tools.name: report_miss
tools.description: Tell EasyCanDo’s owner that search found no tool a step needed, so the catalog and search can improve. Call it only after the user agrees to send it. It sends what you give here: the search (up to 200 characters), what the step needed, and, if you want, a tool you expected and a note. Nothing else f

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_tools, get_tool · Private data: get_tool · Public sink: report_miss.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_tools, get_tool · Private data: get_tool · Public sink: report_miss

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
